messages.subject: Postdoc Position - Elk Ecology and Management
parts:
Please see attached recruitment flier for a 2-year postdoc opportunity related to elk population estimation and habitat use as it relates to various fuels reductions treatments being performed by the Karuk Tribe in Humboldt County, CA. 


Please feel free to forward to your networks or any candidates who might be interested.  I’m happy to answer any questions about it.


Thanks,

Luke Macaulay
